dedupe_keys.name: hydrogen mixture thermodynamic and transport property tables

description: This Figshare deposit supplies thermodynamic and transport-property tables for hydrogen-containing gas streams. The H2ThermoBank research team publishes four Excel workbooks for hydrogen mixed with carbon dioxide, nitrogen, natural gas and methane, together with a document containing detailed results and pure-component properties. The own metadata identifies density, viscosity, thermodynamics and energy-storage applications. Figshare applies CC BY 4.0 with free access. These location-independent property tables are not observations from a particular pipeline or calendar period, and the landing description does not establish the complete numerical pressure and temperature domain without inspecting the files. The tables can parameterize gas-flow and storage simulations or support checks of hydrogen-blending models such as model-blendpath-hydrogen-blending-pipeline-tool. A caveat is that a tabulated mixture composition may differ from the gas being simulated, and numerical extrapolation requires separate justification. The workbooks and supporting document were not downloaded, so their internal units, interpolation rules and boundary cases remain untested.
